hero.opening: Welcome to your personal style app.
hero.paragraph: Designed to help you define your cool girl aesthetic, shop smarter and have more fun with fashion.

inside.heading: What you’ll
inside.intro: Discover app-exclusive brand finds, explore outfit ideas and the latest styling tips, all together in one free app.

features.heading: The Weekly
features.first: Introducing Cool Girl News and Brand Finds.
features.second: All the latest in fashion, from new collections to the coolest collabs, as well as the brands you need on your radar from Australia and around the world. A new edition lands every week, exclusive to the app.

features.heading: Shop the
features.first: Shop all the latest brands and pieces we feature across our socials, from street style fit checks to style guides.
features.second: Everything you’ve got your eye on, conveniently in one place, with every piece linked straight to the brand.

features.heading: Discover and
features.first: Make Cool Girl Wears your own.
features.second: Explore any article, look or styling tip we’ve shared, then save your favourites to build a curated collection that speaks to your style, so your next outfit idea is always one tap away.
